parent.note: PPC-MCTS-01 is frozen by the round brief; the seam cannot be added there.

preparedFork.note: Receives the SAME seam and the SAME trace event points, so "same stop mechanism" is structural rather than asserted.

claim.statement: Apart from (a) the test-only maxCompletedSimulations stop seam and (b) read-only trace instrumentation, the fork performs the same computation as the frozen parent: same thresholds, same tie-breaks, same epsilon comparisons, same iteration order, same RNG construction and seed derivation, same tree expansion, same CHANCE handling, same plan extraction.
claim.whyNotATextStrippingProof: Line-level stripping cannot establish semantic identity (a stripper that deletes the wrong brace still produces a diff of zero, and a catch-all category can force the residue to zero without proving anything). The claim is therefore evidenced twice: every changed line names the parent line it replaces (classification.perLine, UNCLASSIFIED_DIFF_LINES = 0), and the runtime behaviour is compared in probe/impl/phase1Seam.test.ts H1 over 96 fixed-node cells on every comparable field.

categories.name: HEADER_COMMENT
categories.why: Provenance header of the fork. Comments only; no executable content.

categories.name: COMMENT_OR_BLANK
categories.why: Comment or blank line. No executable content.

categories.name: IMPORT_SPECIFIER
categories.why: Same modules, re-based to the fork directory, plus the read-only trace module. No runtime logic.

categories.name: CLASS_RENAME
categories.why: `UctSearch` → `UctSearchBaseline` so the two arms can be imported side by side. Rename only.

categories.name: SEAM_STOP_HOOK
categories.why: Test-only `maxCompletedSimulations` seam: field, option, guarded stop at the TOP of the simulation loop, reported flag. With no value passed it is null and the guard never runs.

categories.name: RNG_INIT_BRANCH
categories.why: The two RNG objects are constructed behind an `if (trace)` branch. Without a sink the branch executes the parent's two `mulberry32(seedFor([...]))` calls verbatim.

categories.name: TRACE_PLUMBING
categories.why: Read-only trace sink: option, field, constructor wiring, helper, plan digest hand-off. Emits values it already has; consumes no RNG and mutates no state.

categories.name: TRACE_EVENT_CALL
categories.why: One `this.tr(...)` emission on its own line. Pure observation of values already computed.

categories.name: TRACE_CALL_ARGUMENT
categories.why: Continuation line (or closing `});`) of a multi-line trace emission. The emitted values are already-computed locals; nothing is read that was not read without the sink.

categories.name: LEAF_VALUE_CARRY
categories.why: `SimOutcome` and the rollout return carry `leafValue` / `terminal` so the trace can record what the reward came from. The value itself is unchanged, still computed once, still returned as `reward`.

categories.name: GUIDANCE_TAP_ARGUMENT
categories.why: `selectRolloutAction(..., tap)` — one extra trailing argument. The function reads it only to record `guidanceValue`; RNG calls and the returned index are unchanged.

categories.name: STRUCTURAL_LINE
categories.why: Brace / bracket / `else` continuation created by splitting a one-line statement into an observed branch. No statement of its own.

categories.name: STATEMENT_SPLIT
categories.why: A one-line `break;` / `return {...}` became a recorded form. Control flow preserved: the same condition, the same body, the same exit.

categories.name: RE_EXPORT_FOR_COMPANION
categories.why: Re-exports a constant that already exists in the parent (`ROOT_TRANSITION`) so the prepared fork can share it. Adds no runtime behaviour to this module.

categories.name: SIGNATURE_WIDENED_SOURCE
categories.why: Parent return-type annotation; the fork adds `leafValue: number; terminal: boolean` to the same annotation. Types only — erases at runtime.

categories.name: STATEMENT_SPLIT_OPEN
categories.why: Opening line of a block the parent wrote as a one-liner `if (COND) { body }`. Same condition, same body, same exit; the block exists so a trace emission can sit inside it.

categories.name: CONDITION_HOIST
categories.why: A side-effect-free condition was bound to a local so the same boolean can be recorded. The parent tested the identical expression inline.

categories.name: CONDITION_HOIST_USE
categories.why: The parent one-line branch with the hoisted expression substituted by its local. Body byte-identical.

categories.name: INLINE_BODY_SPLIT
categories.why: A statement lifted out of a parent one-liner onto its own line, textually identical.

categories.name: STATEMENT_SPLIT_SOURCE
categories.why: Parent one-liner whose statements now appear on separate fork lines; every part is listed as evidence.
